record.original_question: Fix k >= 2. Does there exist m_0 such that whenever m >= m_0 and G is F_{2k+2}-free, then for each residue class l with 1 <= l <= k - 1 and m + k(k+1)/2 == l mod k, the graph G satisfies lambda(G) <= lambda(S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k + (k+3)/2, k}), with equality only for that extremal graph?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.41. Let k >= 2. There is an m0 such that for all m >= m0, and for all G in G(m, F2k+2). If m + k(k+1)/2 == l (mod k) with 1 <= l <= k - 1, then lambda(G) <= lambda(S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k + (k+3)/2, k}). Equality holds if and only if G ~= S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k + (k+3)/2, k}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Notation and setup. For a simple graph $G$, let $\lambda(G)$ denote the spectral radius (largest eigenvalue) of its adjacency matrix. For graphs $H_1,H_2$, let $H_1\vee H_2$ denote their join (add all edges between $V(H_1)$ and $V(H_2)$), and $H_1\cup H_2$ their disjoint union. Let $K_n$ denote the complete graph on $n$ vertices and $tK_1$ the empty graph on $t$ vertices. The fan graph $F_n$ on $n$ vertices is $K_1\vee P_{n-1}$, where $P_{n-1}$ is a path on $n-1$ vertices. A graph is $F$-free if it contains no copy of $F$ as a subgraph. Let $\mathcal G(m,F)$ denote the class of $F$-free graphs with exactly $m$ edges.

For integers $n\ge k+2$ and $0\le l\le k-1$, define
$$S^{1,l}_{n,k}\;:=\;K_l\;\vee\;\bigl((K_{k-l}\vee (n-k-1)K_1)\;\cup\;K_1\bigr).$$

Problem. Fix an integer $k\ge 2$. Decide whether there exists $m_0=m_0(k)$ such that the following holds: for every $m\ge m_0$ and every $G\in\mathcal G(m,F_{2k+2})$, if $1\le l\le k-1$ and
$$m+\frac{k(k+1)}{2}\equiv l\pmod{k},$$
then
$$\lambda(G)\;\le\;\lambda\!\left(S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k+(k+3)/2,\,k}\right),$$
with equality if and only if $G\cong S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k+(k+3)/2,\,k}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is stated as an open problem in a 2025 survey on edge-spectral-Turán type problems. The residue class $l=0$ case was confirmed for $k\ge 3$ and $m\ge 144k^4$, and small cases ($F_5$-free with $m$ even, $F_{2,3}$-free with $m$ even) have been resolved, but the general statement for arbitrary residue classes $1\le l\le k-1$ remains unproven.

status_evidence.title: A survey of edge-spectral-Turán type problems in spectral graph theory
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 3.41. Let k>=2. There is an m0 such that for all m>=m0, and for all G in G(m,F_{2k+2}). If m+k(k+1)/2 ≡ l (mod k) with 1<=l<=k-1, then lambda(G) <= lambda(S^{1,l}_{(m-l)/k+(k+3)/2,k}).
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated as an open conjecture, with only partial cases (specific residues, specific small k) confirmed.

status_evidence.title: Spectral extrema of graphs with fixed size: forbidden a fan graph
status_evidence.snippet: Partial results on F_{2k+2}-free spectral extremal problems for sufficiently large m.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress confirms certain residue cases but not the full conjecture.
